'''2010 Malastare Regionals Eric White DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Eric White]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' SYCFA = Borked
* '''Username:''' TDJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
